description: Search US nonprofits by name. Returns EIN, name, city, state, revenue, assets, and NTEE code. Example: search_nonprofits("red cross", "NY"). Use get_organization with the EIN for full details.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for (e.g., "habitat for humanity")

state.description: Two-letter state code to filter results (e.g., "CA", "NY")

name: search_nonprofits
